children: Annovis Bio entered into an underwriting agreement with Canaccord Genuity for a public offering expected to generate approximately $21.0 million in gross proceeds. The offering includes 19 million common shares, pre-funded warrants for up to 2 million shares in lieu of common stock for certain investors, and accompanying warrants to purchase up to 21 million shares; each share or pre-funded warrant is paired with an accompanying warrant. Proceeds are intended to support clinical studies of Buntanetap for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, as well as working capital and general corporate purposes.
: Underwriting agreement for a public offering
: One-time offering; accompanying warrants expire five years after issuance
: Fund Buntanetap clinical development and general corporate purposes
